notes.title: Achievements Unlocked!
notes.content:
Hallelujah! Esau's World now has achievements!

This was the one feature I was sad to miss on release, and now it's included! Happy achievement hunting!

[list]
[*] Added 25 Achievements
[*] Improved some dialog
[*] Fixed a menu traversal bug on controller
[*] Fixed a bug where Regin wouldn't continue bouncing boxes pushdown down onto his head
[*] Added some SECRETS!
[*] Increased Hope in Life by 7
[/list]

notes.title: Steam Deck Hotfix!
notes.content:
The first ever hotfix for Esau's World! Wahoo!

I'll be adding more in the future! Hopefully with some extra features, but here's where we start!

[list]
[*] Fixed lighting issues in Steam Deck version
[*] Made fullscreen ON the default setting (when fullscreen is turned off on a Steam Deck connected to a secondary monitor, the resolution becomes impossible to see)
[*] Increased handsomeness by 6
[/list]

notes.title: Brother's Keeper: A Developer's Journey
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Q4TTy7RqpSo;full][/previewyoutube]

This week I have had the pleasure of unpacking my thoughts, motivations, and themes for my upcoming puzzle game, Esau's World! There are many layers to this I have trouble talking about, but I hope it comes through in my work that I'm absolutely ecstatic to be so close to finally putting this game in your hands! On that note...

ESAU'S WORLD IS OFFICIALLY RELEASING ON MARCH 22nd!
I've been having friends and coworkers playtest this game and I'm really happy with how far it's come. It's time to let it fly! I'll be putting it on a discount at release, so take a shot at purchasing it as soon as it drops!

A huge thank you to everyone who's been with me on this journey, and to everyone who will be joining me after this! If you wish to join my email list to get updates on future plans, you can join it here:

https://eepurl.com/iqGRUw

Alright, into the developer cave I go! See you in two weeks! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: All the Content is Finished! [New Demo Coming Soon!]
notes.content:
[h1]New Demo Coming Soon![/h1]

October has been an exciting month for Esau’s World! We have officially finished all the game’s main levels! There are still a few cutscenes to hammer out, but this is a HUGE milestone! It’s hard to imagine making it this far when I prototyped the idea for this game at a Game Trailer Jam two years ago.


Here are a few things to look forward to:

[h2]Incremental Mechanics[/h2]
Esau's World is a co-op puzzle game in single player. You set up plans with your brother, Esau, and act them out together!

One of the biggest things I wanted to avoid was throwing players into the system all at once, overwhelming them. To do this I ended up building a lot of inter-mediary systems to help teach different mechanics in isolation (like Regin, the Super-Villanous Worm!). Something I’ve been really excited for is the moment when all of these systems come together and get used all at once! It’s a long journey players have to go through to get there, but that just makes the payoff all the more exciting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948849/eb402fed54f960a9e1bec3031b0a5d8189a2a1a2.png[/img]

[h2]Story[/h2]
Esau’s World has a narrative focus about a magic book that Esau, the main character’s brother, found as a child. The book has the ability to create a sub-world where the book’s owner is a god, able to create anything. This power has proved too tempting, because Esau has hidden himself away within his own world and cut off all connections. Jake, perhaps the only other person who knows about Esau's World, goes looking for him in a moment of crisis, only to find that all is not well in the world Esau has fashioned for himself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948849/b0306984c2bb0a54748e043826e938cfa8a89a24.png[/img]

It’s an ambitious story about something that references my own life story and struggles. This is one of the reasons the game took so long to make! I really wanted to do this story justice and properly portray something I know a lot of other people struggle with too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948849/f6f4791e47b17f519979a9fa67f8f174ae7d2616.png[/img]

[h2]Challenge Rooms (still working on!)[/h2]
Yes! Optional challenge rooms for you to test your cerebral skills and get bragging rights! These are puzzles more difficult than the main campaign, found by looking off the beaten path. Collecting these will find “filled pages”, of some background in Esau’s World, which will flesh out more of the story, so there’s a great incentive to seek them out! They will not be required to understand the story, but getting them will be a real reward!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948849/26770967e543a26e1dc4fedbab35e77440d09a78.png[/img]

[h2]New Demo[/h2]
The next demo will show about 50% of the game's total content. Look forward to this sometime in early January! This is so exciting! I hope you'll join in me in watching how this journey ends!

God Bless You!
Connor

notes.title: Esau's World is joining PixElated Fest on July 29th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948849/92ff6a6f5a5aac5bad96ea2c94ba0ee66a00aff7.png[/img]

We [b]love[/b] pixel art games, and we know you do too. So, let’s celebrate together 🎉 We’re super excited to share that Esau's World is joining PixElated Festival next week! This festival is featuring some of the best pixel art games on Steam. From retro-style classics to contemporary indie gems all in one place!

We will be showcasing a [b]new DEMO[/b] for Esau's World coinciding with the first day of PixElated Fest on July 29th at 8PM BST! There will be ✨ discounts ✨ live streams ✨ art contest ✨ demos✨ developer chats ✨ all centered around your favorite games.

Although Esau's World delves less into the deepest beautiful potential of Pixel Graphics, we are HONORED to be included in this wonderful event! We hope you are excited for our demo and we encourage you to check out some of the other games as well! Check out the official line-up and more information about the event here: http://pixelatedfest.com/
